# Product updates
Date: 2026-10-15 | Duration: 60.029998779296875m

## Summary
The product updates project began 2–3 months ago, with Emmy leading the initial work and Yousef building the CMS and Webflow pages. Automation remains challenging because not every PR is a product update, some PRs are folded or omitted, and human review is needed. Data is stored in Supabase, a dashboard runs on Google Cloud, and a daily batch job runs on Jack’s computer. Fireflies calls, Slack, and Notion are integrated to add customer use cases and workflow context. The preferred content style is customer-first, approachable, clear, and flexible, avoiding excessive technical language, marketing jargon, negative self-talk, unverified claims, and inaccurate historical details. Webflow performance issues include large CSS bundles, image problems, prefetching overload, and an inefficient publishing model. A Focus project may involve a brand refresh, website rebuild, and CMS improvements. Scott is preparing onboarding support and a content strategy that expands beyond SEO into editorial stories about engineering, experimentation, product development, markets, and themes.

## Keywords
Product updates, Supabase, Brand marketing, Content strategy, Website performance, Editorial content
